message.content: On June 26, 2026, LiHua and ChaeSong-hwa had a conversation centered around the progress of their research study. Specifically, they discussed the completion of their research data collection phase, which led to their readiness to test their model. ChaeSong-hwa expressed his excitement about the breakthrough and thanked LiHua for her support, indicating a collaborative and positive working relationship. LiHua congratulated him on the achievement and looked forward to hearing more details about the research findings. The conversation touched upon the hard work and dedication required to reach this point, suggesting that their research project was complex and required significant effort.
